scenes.spoken_text: A drawer combines an opening, box, front and slide system. Separate their dimensions, calculate a declared box-width exercise and examine extension and access.
scenes.caption: A drawer combines an opening, box, front and slide system. Separate their dimensions, calculate a declared box-width exercise and examine extension and access.

scenes.spoken_text: The opening is the available space within the carcass; the box carries contents; the front provides the visible closure. The slide occupies a defined interface between box and carcass. Draw a horizontal section through these elements and a vertical section through the bottom and height. An overlay front may be wider than the box, so record their dimensions separately.
scenes.caption: Opening, box and front dimensions are separate.

scenes.display_title: Calculate box width from the stated slide assumption
scenes.spoken_text: Exercise only: the opening is 560 mm and the teaching system assumes 12.5 mm between box and carcass on each side. External box width is 560 − 12.5 − 12.5 = 535 mm. The combined side allowance is 25 mm. This is neither a drilling layout nor a universal slide clearance; the actual system determines opening, box and bottom relationships.
scenes.caption: Exercise: 560 = 12.5 + 535 + 12.5 mm.

scenes.spoken_text: External carcass depth does not directly specify slide length: the back, services and construction consume internal space. Draw closed and extended positions, checking access to rear contents and collisions involving the front or handle. Partial and full extension affect access differently. Define intended contents and loading, then review the system and inspect movement/alignment against approved requirements.
scenes.caption: Review available depth, extension and access together.

scenes.spoken_text: For the 560 mm opening with 12.5 mm per side, the exercise box is 535 mm. A 560 mm box entry incorrectly copies the opening and exceeds the assumed relationship by 25 mm. Correct it to 535, reconcile the section and keep the front dimension separate. This calculation does not establish product performance. Decision: 535 mm is the box dimension under the assumption; schedule the front separately.
scenes.caption: Decision: 535 mm is the box dimension under the assumption; schedule the front separately.
